# Fathom large-value charts and actual browser zoom

## Prospective resume contract

- Packet: R4/R5, Fathom Observatory and its opt-in app-owned theme guide.
- Need: the integrated mirror reserves more room for large chart labels, but the
  previous browser fixture had small values. Actual 200% browser zoom is also open.
- Deliverable: four light/dark × 100%/200% observations of the real 256px grade and
  560px calls renderers, with 1,000 graded services and calls of 1,234,567 and 1,000.
  A real guide validation/repair/reset journey at 200% supplements chart geometry.
- Inputs: app-kit `dc4bd2f20f3cb7363a8a93236b7acfd61df4f47a`; Fathom working-tree
  integration based on `fa8c8ed854ff319227638c4ef79a15d3c00e50b8`, exact app-kit
  mirror `f7ab0fbd3496e9dc3da8c97b6c4290f09a71ec50`. Reuse the byte-checked private
  source at `/Volumes/m2ext/appkit-evidence/appkit-fathom-integration.SOWNalRa/src`; add only a private
  synthetic test fixture. Preserve existing observations, stash and failed evidence.
- Authority: app-kit assessment/test fixtures and kit commit/push; no active Fathom
  edits, consumer commit/push, mirror/dependency changes, live logs, restart,
  deployment, signing or global/browser-profile configuration changes.
- Acceptance: exact expected labels; SVG glyph containment and non-overlap with
  marks; page and guide reflow; completed assets; actual Chrome zoom verified from
  browser setting, DPR and CSS/layout geometry; native validation and recovery;
  screenshots and exact executed source retained; owned processes exit and port closes.
  Tables/exports are not inferred from direct labels. Real human usability,
  full accessibility, whole-app performance and G3/G4 acceptance remain separate.
- Cost cap: two economical bounded implementers; one initial four-cell acquisition
  and at most one explained harness correction/replay; each acquisition ≤180 seconds,
  roughly 60 minutes for this packet. Stop on a real product failure and retain it
  before separately choosing a scoped repair. No full matrix or retry loop.
- Evidence destination: `/Volumes/m2ext/appkit-evidence/appkit-fathom-large-zoom.Kdko9rO3`;
  [portable fixture](fixtures/fathom-large-zoom/README.md). The app-kit maintainer
  owns the return. No quality-tier promotion follows from this bounded check.

## Result

**Automated observations pass; complete appearance acceptance remains open.**
The final binary compiled offline in 58 seconds; its deterministic model test passes.
All 14 pure zoom/refusal tests pass. Acquisition 03 passes 118 named checks over four
chart cells and one light/200% guide journey. Node 26.3.0, Playwright 1.62.1 and
Chrome 153.0.8010.53 are pinned by executable/module hashes, not names alone.

| Observation | Result and boundary |
|---|---|
| Actual renderers and selected source | Eleven selected production files match the active consumer; full private build source retained. No active source was changed. |
| Large direct labels | A=`1,000`, find_symbol=`1,234,567`, references=`1,000`; exact SVG text, glyph containment and no text/bar overlap pass in light/dark at 100%/200%. |
| Native browser zoom | Appearance control, DPR 1/2, inner 1440/720, outer 1440 and scale 1 agree. Content 1425/712 reflects the native scrollbar; no horizontal overflow. |
| Styles/assets | Every observed app CSS body matches the actual consumer's 33,879-byte stylesheet; fonts/styles and response bodies complete. Computed theme colors differ as intended. |
| Keyboard guide task | Native Tab/Enter: invalid radius → 422 and focused error → repair link → 1rem preview 200 → reset. Selected controls and opaque preview fit. Dark/200 guide journey was not run. |
| Normal-size visual review | Both charts and values are visible in the inspected light/dark 100% captures. |
| Zoomed visual review | Grade values are visible, but 200% captures have unexplained blank regions and both call-chart captures omit their target. **Not accepted**, despite the passing bounding-box oracle. Cause is not established. |
| Payload | Each synthetic 1000-service page is approximately 1.91 MB. This is a geometry stress fixture, not a performance recommendation or budget pass. |
| Lifecycle | Fixture and owned Chrome exit 0, output drains, no forced kill, final port refuses. No blocked page requests or transport failures; only the expected 422 validation response/console diagnostic, no unexpected errors. |

The machine report's `passed` means its automated observations, not the separate visual
review. No full Impeccable audit score, quality-tier promotion or G3/G4 completion is
awarded. The fixture also leaves service call totals at zero while per-tool rows are
positive; it is **not** an overview/chart agreement oracle. Reconcile that synthetic
model before any semantic promotion. The normal guide uses its unchanged real fixture.

## Retained preparation findings

The first model test passed against the retained first fixture. Review then found an
extra mirror-default theme stylesheet in that fixture, while Fathom's actual compiled
app CSS already includes its app-owned tokens. The fixture now loads only that actual
app CSS. Original fixture bytes remain in `pre-build-source.tar`; no original test or
browser result is reclassified as current palette evidence.

The first test-binary build failed with external-volume cache/temp `Operation not
permitted` errors, and its owner also failed to write the final JSON receipt. Stderr
and the executed harness are retained; no successful build is claimed. A new private
internal staging root, `/private/tmp/appkit-fathom-large-build.DUHRy9fn`, avoids external
source/build-temp writes. Its initial policy refused the module cache because
`/Users/geoff/.dev-cache/go/modules` resolves to `/Volumes/m2ext/dev-cache/go/modules`.
The next policy admits read-only access to that exact cache while retaining the rest
of the volume denial. No host permission or global cache configuration was changed.
These are distinct preparation failures, not repeated browser acquisitions.

Acquisition 01 stopped before pages: the extra outer test sandbox denied Chrome's
local `SingletonSocket`. Acquisition 02 sandboxed only the synthetic server and kept
Chrome's normal sandbox/fresh profile. It completed all four cells and the native
guide journey, but failed four zoom assertions: content width excluded a 15-physical-
pixel native scrollbar, unlike the oracle's fixed 1440/720 assumption. Its four
200% element captures were blank. The failed report and captures remain unchanged.

An explicit, independently reviewed cap extension admits exactly one final replay
within this packet's 60-minute maintenance budget, not a new broad matrix. The
prospective oracle still requires the real Appearance setting, DPR, inner/outer
width and visualViewport scale; content widths must agree with document extent and
the integer CSS-pixel rounding interval. Invalid/missing/overflow/squeezed inputs
have pure refusal controls. Capture now scrolls the actual SVG into view, proves its
box fits and saves the whole painted viewport, without scaling or cropping pixels.
Manual image inspection remains distinct from automated geometry. Neither the UI,
fixture values nor original failed results change. No further acquisition is planned.
